promptText: Which hotel brands should an owner consider when evaluating branded residences as part of a hotel project in the Caribbean and Latin America?
rawText:
This is a great question with significant strategic implications for hotel developers. Based on the latest market intelligence from industry conferences, investment summits, and brand announcements, here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands an owner should consider when evaluating branded residences in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA):

---

## 🏨 Hotel Brands to Consider for Branded Residences in the Caribbean & Latin America

### Why Branded Residences Matter in This Region


According to panelists at the 2025 Caribbean Hotel Investment Conference & Operations Summit, providing branded residences is a win-win scenario for owners who can see a faster return on investment with buyers coming in on the rental units.
 
In the ultra-luxury segment, developers like Six Senses are working on deals at $3 million-plus per key, meaning leveraging that capital is critical. As one Six Senses executive put it, branded residences are "a requirement, not an ominous cherry on top, especially in the ultra-luxury world with construction costs and labor costs at the highest they've ever been."



The major international brands and developers continue to increase their presence throughout CALA by developing branded residences and highly experiential lodging properties.


---

### 1. 🏅 **Marriott International** *(Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W, Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, Bvlgari)*

Marriott is the dominant force in branded residences in the Americas. 
For the Americas region, Marriott remains comfortably in first place with the highest number of completed schemes for hotel operators.



Marriott International's portfolio in the Caribbean and Latin America encompasses brands including St. Regis and Ritz-Carlton.
 
In the luxury space, being able to use branded residences as leverage in the development process has been extremely important, according to Marriott's director of feasibility and development, who noted that nine of the 10 projects he's working on will include branded residences.


Key pipeline projects include: 
Bvlgari Resort & Residences, Cave, Exuma in the Bahamas, and Cotton Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve and Residences in Eleuthera, Bahamas, both expected to open in 2029.


**Best Marriott brands for residences in CALA:** Ritz-Carlton / Ritz-Carlton Reserve, St. Regis, W Residences, Luxury Collection, and Autograph Collection.

---

### 2. 🏅 **Hilton** *(Waldorf Astoria, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Conrad, Curio Collection)*

Hilton has made branded residences a central part of its CALA growth strategy. 
Hilton expanded its branded residences strategy with new signings
 throughout the region. 
Demand in the CALA region has grown 14%, and Hilton expects that to continue.


Notable recent moves include: 
the debut of Waldorf Astoria Residences Costa Rica and the signing of Waldorf Astoria Residences Guadalajara — the first-ever standalone Waldorf Astoria branded residences in the Caribbean and Latin America — offering one-to-four-bedroom homes with world-class amenities.



Hilton also signed a new ultra-luxury resort and residences in Manuel Antonio, Costa Rica, which will offer 170 guest rooms and one- to four-bedroom homes and is slated to join the LXR Hotels & Resorts collection in 2029.



Waldorf Astoria Dellis Cay and AMARIS Grace Bay, LXR Hotels & Resorts are both set to open in Turks & Caicos, while Conrad Los Cabos is among the highly anticipated Mexican arrivals. Two new Conrad properties were also signed: Conrad Lima, a 21-story oceanfront retreat in Lima's vibrant Miraflores district planned for 2028, and Conrad Monterrey.


**Best Hilton brands for residences in CALA:** Waldorf Astoria Residences, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Conrad.

---

### 3. 🏅 **IHG Hotels & Resorts** *(Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton)*


IHG is actively growing its branded residences presence in CALA. It is focusing mainly on its Kimpton brand, but also has deals in the works for properties under the Regent, Six Senses, and InterContinental brands.



Many of these will offer branded residences, including a forthcoming joint Kimpton hotel and residence in Tulum, Mexico.


Six Senses is a particularly powerful brand for residences: 
offering branded residences is more than just a bonus at this point, according to Six Senses' director of development.
 
In Belize, Six Senses has introduced overwater residences with starting prices around $3.75 million USD, and the brand positions its residences as long-horizon wellness investments rather than pure yield plays.



IHG states it is "really focusing growth on the branded residence phase for luxury brands or entry-level luxury in the case of Kimpton."


**Best IHG brands for residences in CALA:** Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton.

---

### 4. 🏅 **Hyatt** *(Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, Grand Hyatt, Alila)*


Hyatt is seeing increasing demand for its branded residences — one of the fastest-growing segments of luxury real estate globally. Hyatt's growing branded residential portfolio includes brands like Park Hyatt, Thompson Hotels, Andaz, The Standard, and Miraval.



Park Hyatt Los Cabos at Cabo del Sol is slated to open as the first Park Hyatt hotel in Mexico, with 163 ocean-view guestrooms and suites and 19 for-sale villas and residences.



Grand Hyatt Grand Cayman Hotel & Residences will mark the first Hyatt-branded hotel in the Cayman Islands, offering 351 guestrooms, studio suites, and one-, two-, and three-bedroom layouts.



The momentum continues with forthcoming openings through 2027, including Andaz Turks & Caicos at Grace Bay, Grand Hyatt Los Cabos, Grand Hyatt St. Lucia, Park Hyatt Cancun, Park Hyatt Mexico City, Thompson Monterrey, and Thompson Puerto Vallarta.



Alila Mayakoba will mark the debut of the Alila brand in Latin America and the Caribbean, offering a wellbeing sanctuary with a collection of 118 guestrooms and 64 suites.


**Best Hyatt brands for residences in CALA:** Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, Alila, Grand Hyatt.

---

### 5. 🏅 **Four Seasons**


Four Seasons is one of the world's leading hospitality brands for branded residences in the Caribbean and Latin America, offering private villas, lavish condominiums and ready-to-build home sites with unrestricted access to an array of resort amenities.
 Four Seasons Residences are consistently among the most sought-after branded residential offerings in markets like Los Cabos, Costa Rica, and the Caribbean. 
Four Seasons ranks among the top parent companies for branded residences in the Americas.


---

### 6. 🏅 **Rosewood Hotels & Resorts**

Rosewood is a standout ultra-luxury brand for branded residences. 
New 5-star residential resort developments from Rosewood are setting a new standard for super-luxury in Latin America and the Caribbean.
 The brand is especially active in Mexico and the broader CALA market, appealing to buyers at the very top of the market.

---

### 7. 🏅 **Fairmont** *(Accor Group)*


Fairmont is another brand setting a new standard for luxury in Latin America and the Caribbean
, with developments like Fairmont Residences Mayakoba on the Riviera Maya being a landmark project. Fairmont's affiliation with the Accor group gives it broad distribution reach and loyalty program support.

---

### 8. 🏅 **Mandarin Oriental**


Mandarin Oriental is among the world-leading hospitality brands for luxury branded residences in the Caribbean.
 The brand is known for its exceptional service standards and premium pricing power, which makes it a compelling option for owners seeking to maximize residential sales prices.

---

## 📊 Key Considerations for Owners Evaluating Brands

| Factor | What to Evaluate |
|---|---|
| **Brand Prestige** | Premium pricing power for residential sales (e.g., Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Waldorf Astoria, Six Senses, Four Seasons command top-of-market pricing) |
| **Loyalty Program** | Size of the brand's loyalty database (Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors, World of Hyatt drive rental demand) |
| **Pipeline Activity** | Brands actively signing CALA deals (Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG all have aggressive regional pipelines) |
| **Standalone Residences** | Some brands (e.g., Waldorf Astoria, Marriott Autograph) now allow standalone residential projects without an attached hotel |
| **Wellness Positioning** | Six Senses and Alila are strong for wellness-focused developments, commanding ultra-premium pricing |
| **Developer Experience** | Look for brands with CALA-specific development teams experienced in the region's financing environment |


Aligning your property with globally respected hotel and hospitality brands significantly enhances its asset value and rental potential, as these developments benefit from high demand sustained by world-class branding, professional management, and incomparable attention to detail.
